dogecoin.text: @PabloDiez_p @MattWallace888 @elonmusk Almost all cryptos have a logo. What are you going to tell me next Dogecoin is intrinsically valuable because of its name?

@MattWallace888 @elonmusk There is nothing intrinsically valuable about Dogecoin. There is no added feature or utility that makes it special or different from the thousands of other cryptos. The only value comes from the promise of making money if you buy in and pump so others buy in as well.
